messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: service `inference-api` -> v2.3.4-alpha at 10% (us-west only). Change summary: tokenizer fix, KV cache tuning. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx > 1% or p95 latency > 350ms over 5m. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-03-23/v2.3.4
amy: LGTM. @raj can you watch telemetry for the first 10m?
raj: on it. firing synthetic smoke + canary-sample set now.
dana: quick question - did we exclude the large-embed orgs from this wave?
sasha: yes, excluded high-throughput tenants. this is user-traffic only.
raj: 2m in: p50 ok, p95 creeping 310 -> 335ms, 5xx 0.2%. trending stable so far.
amy: :thumbsup: keep an eye. remember quiet window starts 22:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Traffic policy applied. us-west: 10% -> v2.3.4, eu-west: 0%. Telemetry: https://dashboards/release/1716007777
raj: FYI an unrelated signal: eu edge routers reporting 502s from tokenizer service (0.6%). region not in rollout. looking into root cause.
sasha: tagging @infra - could this be shared tokenizer regression?
infra: investigating. seeing CPU contention on tokenizer hosts in eu-west-1, increased batch job throughput around the same time. doesn't appear tied to this staged rollout.
amy: since eu isn't in the wave, i'd still prefer a cautious ramp. recommend we pause any further percentage increases and run extended canary tests for 5-10m.
raj: agree. pausing ramp. will watch for 10m. please cast quick votes: GO / HOLD for additional ramp.
dana: HOLD until infra confirms root cause resolved.
infra: root cause identified: misrouted batch jobs hammered tokenizer pool. mitigated by throttling batch queue and removing a bad deploy in batch-worker. 502s dropping.
raj: metrics improving: us-west p95 ~320ms, eu 502s down to 0.08%. suggest extend watch 5m then re-evaluate.
sasha: GO for additional +10% -> 20% in us-west only, keep eu excluded. @deploy-bot please execute gradual shift.
deploy-bot: Initiating traffic shift: us-west 10% -> 20% (staggered across zones). will post on completion.
deploy-bot: Shift complete. us-west now at 20% for v2.3.4. Observability: https://dashboards/release/1716007777/20pct
amy: post-shift quick check: p95 ticked to ~340ms in a couple of tails. decision: hold at 20% for 30m and collect additional eval sets before further ramp.
raj: agree. pin regional version to avoid accidental cross-shift: `pin-version --service inference-api --region eu-west --version v2.3.3`
sasha: will append addendum to release notes w/ clarified rollback triggers and hold policy. note: "Hold at 20% if p95 > 400ms or 5xx > 1% over 5m".
dana: ack. if we see regression I'll trigger rollback: `deploy rollback inference-api --to v2.3.3 --regions us-west`
deploy-bot: Hold placed. rollout paused at 20% (us-west). Logging this thread for audit.
amy: thanks everyone — we'll reconvene in 30m or sooner if anything pops. :coffee:
